## Summary

**MOVEA** (Move Address).

## Details

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Operation | `<ea> → Bn` |
| Syntax | `MOVEA <ea>,Bn` |
| Description | Move the source into a B-address register. |
| Constraints | No LEA (Bn),Bm or MOVEA.L Bn,Bm |
| Condition codes | not affected |

### Encoding

| Word | Bits | Content |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 15–12 | `0001` |
| 1 | 11–9 | Bn |
| 1 | 8–6 | `001` |
| 1 | 5–3 | Mode |
| 1 | 2–0 | Register |

- Size is long. Can be banked so &lt;ea&gt; includes En.
- &lt;ea&gt; does not allow An (or Bn)

## Differences from AmigaOS / AROS / 68060

- The 68000–68060 have MOVEA. This page covers only the 68080 addition: MOVEA with a B address register as destination. For the classic forms, the Motorola manual applies.

## Do / Don't

- DON'T write LEA (Bn),Bm or MOVEA.L Bn,Bm: B to B is not supported.
- DON'T use An or Bn as the source `<ea>`.
